explication: gem5 is a modular computer-system simulator used to evaluate hardware designs and system software. The principal workflow is to configure a simulated system, instantiate its SimObjects, and execute simulation; Python configuration and the C++ configuration manager are visible, but the standard runtime entry point was not sampled, so that connection is shown as unverified. The graph also preserves processor, GPU, memory-coherence, power-model, and optional SystemC capabilities. Relationships are limited to README statements and source-index references or excerpts; unsampled subsystems are not treated as inspected.
